stem:
Meera watches the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur for a month. She notices that the bright part of the Moon looks different on different nights, changing from a thin crescent to a full circle and back again.

Which statement correctly explains what she sees?

options.text: The Moon's own shape changes as it moves around the Earth
The bright part of the Moon seen from Earth changes as sunlight falls on different parts of the Moon
The Moon makes its own light, and this light becomes stronger and weaker
Clouds and shadows cover the Moon, so its shape looks different

teacher.key_rationale: Phases of the Moon are caused by the changing portion of the sunlit half of the Moon that is visible from Earth as the Moon orbits; the Moon neither changes its actual shape nor produces its own light, so B is correct.
